name: Binance public data (data.binance.vision)
rate_limits: No published numbers for the file archive; the dataset terms say to respect posted limits or risk an IP ban. The live binance.com API returns HTTP 451 from US addresses (tested earlier).
history_start: Spot BTCUSDT daily klines from 2017-08; USD-M futures funding rates from 2020-01.
what_it_has: Daily and monthly zip files of spot and futures klines, trades and aggregate trades, plus futures funding rates, each with a SHA256 checksum.
simple: The biggest crypto exchange posts free files of every past crypto price and trade.
license_terms: Data is under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 per the Binance Vision Dataset Terms (updated 2026-08-26). Academic research and personal backtesting are allowed; commercial use, live trading use and paid signals are not. https://github.com/binance/binance-public-data/blob/master/TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS.md
quality_notes: Spot timestamps switch from milliseconds to microseconds from 2025-01-01. Binance sometimes replaces archived files; the repo logs these corrections. Crypto only.

relevance.reason: Best free crypto history and funding rates if we compare FX carry with crypto carry.
